what_this_is: Facts extracted from each strategy's canonical file so an LLM can state its idea. Read `docstring`, `settings`, `indicators` and `signals`; do not infer beyond them.
how_to_answer: Write evidence/STRATEGY_IDEAS.json: one entry per family with `family`, `stem` (the mechanical family the rows are grouped by), `read_from` ({strategy_id, source_sha256} - the one revision the sentences were read from), `idea` (2-3 sentences: what it trades, on which signal, how it exits), `versions` (a short note per era of the family: what changed from one revision to the next, from the `settings`, `indicators`, `signals` and `functions` below), `evidence` (the code facts the sentence rests on) and `exclude` for any row of the stem the family does not cover, with a reason.
